pattern.description: The cursor travels from the board to the Share button and clicks; the button takes a focus ring and pressed state, a Share popover opens, and its access notice loads in a frame later, pushing the Manage access, full-screen toggle and Copy link rows down.
pattern.why_premium: The click lands right after 'organized by this field.', opening the next topic (sharing views) on the narration break so the UI action marks the new beat.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.cursor', {x: 280, y: -420, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.inOut'}); tl.set('.share-btn', {className: 'btn focus'}); tl.set('.share-btn', {className: 'btn pressed'}, '+=0.07'); tl.set('.share-popover', {autoAlpha: 1}, '<'); tl.set('.access-notice', {display: 'block'}, '+=0.03') so following rows reflow down (optionally .from('.access-notice', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.1, ease: 'power1.out'})).
build_hint.remotion: Cursor path with interpolate + Easing.inOut(Easing.cubic) over about 8 frames; button state and popover visibility as frame-threshold booleans; render the access notice from frame open+1 so flex layout pushes rows down (no spring).

notes: The popover first renders a loading layout (Manage access at the top) and the Open access notice appears one or two frames later; this has a hint of skeleton_resolve, but the main beat is a cursor click, so cursor_guided_demo was chosen. A brief 'Performance improvements' tooltip flashes mid-burst and has no end-frame box.
